svg.title: Step 6: Personal e-mail (now versus target)
svg.desc: Step 6 Personal e-mail. Now: Writing standard hard-codes the candidate; Technology check knows 35 terms; Vision phrases are not banned; Resume line is required; False positive. Target: Anatomy, at most 120 words; Checker; One follow-up in the same thread; Drafting evals for jw. Metric: The probe drafts from section 1 are blocked; human reply rate is measured against the pre-change baseline.
